title: Legacy Serial Write
text: Write output data for baseboard serial communications, 1 input, {Output Datatype} sets Select output data type 8 bit uint null; {Serial port} sets the port that is being accessed Legacy Serial and {SampleTime} selects sample time. Values come from the instance.
